==Ingredients==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 4.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]
*¾ cup (200 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 6.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]] juice
*⅝ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) natural (plain) [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
*⅔ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) ice cubes
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
==Procedure==
#Cut off the tops of the strawberries.
#Peel the bananas.
#Blend all the ingredients in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth.
#Add honey to taste.
#Pour the smoothie into 2 glasses.
#Enjoy!
